The kids in Texas don’t deserve it.

The kids in Gaza don’t deserve it.

The kids in Sudan don’t deserve it.

The kids in Congo don’t deserve it.

The kids in Iran don’t deserve it.

The kids in Iraq don’t deserve it.

The kids in Ukraine don’t deserve it.

The kids in Russia don’t deserve it.

The kids in Yemen don’t deserve it.

The kids in Afghanistan don’t deserve it.

The kids in Syria don’t deserve it.

The kids in Nigeria don’t deserve it.

The kids in Myanmar don’t deserve it.

The kids in Bangladesh don’t deserve it.

The kids in Pakistan don’t deserve it.

The kids in Philippines don’t deserve it.

The kids in Indonesia don’t deserve it.

The kids in Nepal don’t deserve it.

The kids in India don’t deserve it.

The kids of 'anywhere' don’t deserve it.

Adults are the problem, not kids.

We ignite wars, sow hatred, and defend broken systems that destroy futures.

We fire essential weather service and climate experts responsible for local forecasts and life-saving emergency alerts.

We ignore climate warnings, leaving future generations to face floods, fires, and famine.

We build walls and borders, turning away children fleeing violence and poverty.

We spread misinformation and division, teaching kids to fear instead of understand.

We allow child labour and exploitation to persist, robbing millions of their innocence.

We prioritise profit over people, letting corporations poison communities where children play.

We fail to protect children from abuse and neglect, turning a blind eye to their suffering.

We let poverty persist, so children go to bed hungry in a world of abundance.

We ignore the voices of the young, dismissing their hopes and ideas for a better world.

We make decisions behind closed doors, without considering the impact on the next generation.

We let gun violence rage, turning schools and playgrounds into places of fear.

We allow discrimination and injustice to thrive, teaching children that some lives matter less.

We chase short-term gains, sacrificing the planet and our children’s future for convenience.

We have failed our children.

And we will keep failing them, until something truly changes.

Children must be protected, at all costs, and without exception.
